gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 3244.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured red in Drawing No. KH3379, commencing at its junction with Sai Yee Street running in a easterly direction for about 60 metres and terminating with Kowloon-Canton Railway boundary. Proposed Name: BUTE STREET. Chinese Version: 弼街.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路位置在 KH3379 號圖則上以紅色標明，起點與洗衣街連接，向東伸展約六十米，在九廣鐵路分界線終結。
